notes: Complete 594-page accessible PDF reviewed on 2026-09-27, covering all 29 chapters, appendices and a full-volume visual scan.

High conceptual relevance to multi-signal forecasting: value, carry, momentum, macro, sentiment, liquidity/risk, signal strength, predictive ability, correlated-predictor deduplication and regime context.

Book-level synthesis published in 2011; multi-asset and longer-horizon findings require BTC-specific validation before implementation.

sources.title: Systematic Trading: A Unique New Method for Designing Trading and Investing Systems
notes: Complete accessible 359-page PDF reviewed on 2026-09-27, including all 15 chapters, epilogue, glossary, Appendices A-D, and full-document visual scan.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-004-SYSTEMATIC-TRADING.md

Key source domains: ideas-first research, fitting/overfitting, continuous normalized forecasts, correlation-aware forecast combination, robust weighting, volatility targeting, position sizing, portfolios, transaction-cost speed limits, position inertia, EWMAC and carry examples.

The book provides a professional precedent for stable structural weighting with cautious evidence-dependent performance adjustment, but no Trading Bot numeric weights or BTC parameters are derived from it.
Cross-asset/daily-futures architecture and author-specific numerical heuristics require BTC-specific evidence before any implementation.

sources.title: Market Wizards: The Next Generation — The World’s Top Young Traders Reveal How They Beat the Market
notes: Complete 332-page accessible PDF reviewed on 2026-09-27, including both prefaces, all nine trader interviews, trade-chart visual scan, epilogue, all three appendices and performance-verification notes.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-005-MARKET-WIZARDS-THE-NEXT-GENERATION.md
Bibliographic inconsistency preserved: publication page says first published 2025; copyright and both prefaces indicate 2026.

Practitioner interview evidence only: performance verification increases authenticity of reported records but does not eliminate selection/survivorship bias or establish causal efficacy of the methods.
No BTC alpha, numeric signal weight or implementation parameter is derived from this source.

sources.title: Trend Following: Equity and Bond Crisis Alpha
notes: Complete 15-page PDF reviewed on 2026-09-27, including all sections, equations, tables, figures, references and appendix sensitivity analyses.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-006-MAN-AHL-TREND-FOLLOWING-EQUITY-AND-BOND-CRISIS-ALPHA.md
The paper studies cross-asset monthly trend-following from 1960-2015, including pre/post-1985 bond regimes, skewness and equity/bond crisis-alpha behavior.
momCTA is a constrained BTOP50-replication calibration, not a pristine independent test of that exact weighting profile.
Core performance results are simulated and gross of transaction costs and fees; no BTC-specific weight, horizon or parameter is derived.

sources.title: Trend Following and Drawdowns: Is This Time Different?
notes: Complete 18-page PDF reviewed on 2026-09-27, including all 12 figures, bibliography and disclosures.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-007-TREND-FOLLOWING-AND-DRAWDOWNS-IS-THIS-TIME-DIFFERENT.md
Historical index evidence, hypothetical IID-normal simulations, and practitioner opinion are explicitly separated in the dossier.

Key retained concepts: edge decay can be horizon-specific; drawdown alone does not prove strategy death; whipsaw regimes are structurally hostile to trend; drawdown-based deallocation can create opportunity cost when underlying expectancy is unchanged.
No BTC trend parameter, signal weight, drawdown threshold or deployment rule is derived from this source.

sources.title: Which Trend Is Your Friend?
notes: Complete published paper reviewed on 2026-09-27, including all article pages, 14 figures, 2 empirical tables, Appendices A-C, notes and references.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-008-WHICH-TREND-IS-YOUR-FRIEND.md
Central result: generalized TSMOM and MACROSS are equivalent linear trend-filter representations; many other causal linear time-invariant filters map into the same broad family.
Empirical study uses 58 traditional futures/forward instruments from 1985-01 through 2015-04; reported strategy performance is before transaction costs.
No BTC-specific horizon, signal weight, or parameter is derived from this source.

sources.title: A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following Investing
notes: Complete 16-page published paper reviewed on 2026-09-27, including exhibits, appendices, endnotes, references, and visual page inspection.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-009-A-CENTURY-OF-EVIDENCE-ON-TREND-FOLLOWING-INVESTING.md
Study covers a diversified 67-market monthly time-series-momentum strategy from 1880-2016 using equal-weighted 1m/3m/12m signals, volatility scaling and simulated transaction costs.
Paper provides strong external trend evidence but does not validate BTCUSDT intraday alpha or any Trading Bot signal weight/parameter.
Related TSMOM/trend sources must not be counted as fully independent evidence in final synthesis.

sources.title: Advances in Financial Machine Learning
notes: Complete 518-page accessible PDF reviewed on 2026-09-27, covering all 22 chapters plus visual verification of chapter openings and key figures/tables.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-012-ADVANCES-IN-FINANCIAL-MACHINE-LEARNING.md

Key domains covered: event-based sampling, triple-barrier/meta-labeling, sample uniqueness, fractional differentiation, purged CV/embargo, feature importance, tuning, bet sizing, backtest-overfitting controls, CPCV, backtest statistics, strategy risk, structural breaks, entropy, microstructure, and computational infrastructure.
López de Prado's strict anti-refinement backtest doctrine is preserved as a source position and explicitly not treated as universal corpus consensus.
No claim is made that Trading Bot should become a black-box ML system; no BTC signal weight, parameter, System G2 design, or market experiment is derived from this source.

sources.title: The Deflated Sharpe Ratio: Correcting for Selection Bias, Backtest Overfitting and Non-Normality
notes: Complete 22-page PDF reviewed on 2026-09-27, including all main sections, appendices, code snippet, exhibits and references, with full visual page verification.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-013-DEFLATED-SHARPE-RATIO.md
Core retained lesson: Sharpe significance must account for multiple testing/search history, trial redundancy, sample length, skewness and kurtosis.
DSR is treated as a research-evidence diagnostic, not an alpha generator or substitute for causal data/execution correctness.
No BTC alpha, signal weight, parameter or System G2 rule is derived from this paper.

sources.title: … and the Cross-Section of Expected Returns
notes: Complete 101-page SSRN manuscript reviewed on 2026-09-27, including main text, full factor list, bibliography, Appendices A-E, and full-document visual scan.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-016-CROSS-SECTION-OF-EXPECTED-RETURNS.md
Source-grounded metadata: current manuscript version April 20, 2015; first posted to SSRN April 11, 2013.
Core use for Trading Bot is research-multiplicity governance: failed/hidden trials, correlated hypotheses, theory-vs-mining distinction, and stronger evidence after broad search.
The paper's t-statistic guidance is contextual to cross-sectional factor research and is not adopted as a universal BTC strategy threshold.

sources.title: Mathematical Appendices to “The Probability of Backtest Overfitting”
notes: Complete 8-page mathematical supplement reviewed on 2026-09-27, including all synthetic test cases, Monte Carlo benchmark, EVT/Gumbel derivation, Python snippets, and final accuracy table.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-017-MATHEMATICAL-APPENDICES-PROBABILITY-OF-BACKTEST-OVERFITTING.md
The appendix reports CSCV/PBO accuracy under controlled synthetic assumptions; it is not independent trading-alpha evidence.
Core project implication: candidate-search breadth and sample size jointly determine selection-overfit risk; complete trial logging is required.
No signal weight, BTC parameter, or strategy design is derived from this source.

sources.title: The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
notes: Complete 34-page PDF reviewed on 2026-09-27, including all 13 figures, formal definitions, CSCV algorithm, practical examples, limitations and misuse warnings.
Dossier: research/library/source_notes/LIB-018-THE-PROBABILITY-OF-BACKTEST-OVERFITTING.md
Key scope: PBO evaluates strategy/configuration-selection overfit; it does not validate backtest correctness, costs, data timing, or future regime robustness.
Full legitimate trial disclosure is required; hiding failed trials or padding with obviously bad trials biases the diagnostic.
PBO/CSCV must not be used as the strategy-search objective itself.
No BTC alpha, signal weight, parameter, or System G2 rule is derived from this source.
